content:
Harish Reddy: tracking open issues for stage 2 rollout (next region) before we flip any flags. us-east A100 looks stable-ish now, but we’ve got a couple networking dependencies called out by AWS + SRE. Can we use this thread as the running list + owners?

Vanessa Ortiz: +1. Stage 2 target is us-west (A100) unless we hear otherwise. We’re blocked on a couple items that are basically “networking says no” right now.

Jamal Pierce: for clarity: capacity team has us-west A100 inventory reserved for next week. If we slip, we’ll lose the window and it’ll push into the next train.

Gabe Wilson: dumping what I have from last sync:
- VPC CNI config drift in us-west cluster (MTU mismatch vs us-east) -> affects NCCL + node validation network throughput check
- new security group rule set for validation agent egress (artifact upload + readiness svc)
- AWS placement group / EFA settings parity with us-east module
- route53 / internal DNS for readiness service endpoint in us-west

Keiko Yamamoto: adding autoscaling guardrail item: stage2 shouldn’t enable burst until we validate the failure rate is < threshold. Current terraform defaults might allow pool autoscale to ramp too fast in a new region.

Nina Petrova: MTU is the scary one. If we’re at 1500 in one subnet and 9001 in another, NCCL all-reduce can “work” but will be wildly flaky / slow + we’ll quarantine half the pool.

Rafael Mendes: SRE ask: please don’t repeat the metric tag incident in a new region. Confirm the step metrics are using low-cardinality tags only (region, gpu_type, step, outcome). No node_id, no instance_id.

Aisha Bello: ^ dashboards are already showing a tiny uptick in us-east for `net_throughput` failures (not paging, just tickets). If us-west has MTU issues it’ll light up immediately. Link: https://grafana.redwood.inference/d/ptr-step-breakdown (internal)

Sahana Iyer: image pipeline note: us-west AMI copy is currently 1 version behind stable (stable=img-2025.02.20.3, us-west has img-2025.02.20.2). Copy job failed yesterday due to permissions on the target KMS key. I’m fixing but stage2 should not start until the region is on stable.

Connor O'Brien: release train wise: if we want stage2 next week, I need a go/no-go checklist by EOD Thu. Otherwise we miss the change window.

Harish Reddy: ok, turning into an explicit list. Please reply with owner + ETA.

Harish Reddy: 1) Networking/MTU parity in us-west cluster (must match us-east baseline) — owner?

Nina Petrova: I’ll take point but I need the network team to confirm the target MTU. Historically: jumbo (9001) in the GPU worker subnets. Action: validate across all subnets used by the dedicated node groups.

Vanessa Ortiz: I can ping the network oncall and get an answer today. We should also bake an explicit MTU check into preflight (agent can read iface MTU) so we fail fast.

Gabe Wilson: we already have a lightweight MTU probe in the validation agent but it’s currently WARN-only (for us-east because we didn’t want to block rollout). We can flip it to FAIL for stage2 if we’re comfortable.

Rafael Mendes: I’d prefer FAIL for stage2. Otherwise we’ll “succeed” provisioning and then eat quarantine later. If there’s concern, gate it behind the region feature flag.

Harish Reddy: 2) Security group / egress allowlist for validation agent (readiness svc + artifact storage) — owner?

Vanessa Ortiz: I can handle with SecOps consult. Fiona is out today but Marcus might be around.

Aisha Bello: please include logs pipeline endpoints too. Last time we had missing egress to `logs-collector.internal` and validations “passed” but no artifacts -> no triage.

Harish Reddy: 3) Readiness service endpoint / internal DNS in us-west — owner?

Gabe Wilson: platform owns the readiness service, but I can coordinate. We need a us-west-ready endpoint + route in the internal mesh.

Vanessa Ortiz: Ethan/Benji are already doing the multi-region readiness svc work. I’ll ask them what the “ready” state is for us-west.

Harish Reddy: 4) Terraform parity: placement group/EFA + required tags/outputs in the us-west module — owner?

Keiko Yamamoto: I can do terraform diff against us-east module + verify rollout vars. There was a note in #eng-infra about missing `image_channel` output in one region.

Jamal Pierce: please keep `pool_id` tagging consistent. capacity reporting depends on it.

Harish Reddy: 5) AMI copy + KMS permissions (stable image in us-west) — owner?

Sahana Iyer: me. I have the KMS grant change queued. ETA: today EOD for the copy job rerun, tomorrow morning for verification.

Connor O'Brien: can we add explicit “image stable” check in the go/no-go? I don’t want us to approve rollout and then discover we’re still on candidate.

Vanessa Ortiz: yes. We’ll add to checklist: `image_channel=stable` + exact version pinned.

Harish Reddy: 6) Validation gate tuning in new region: NCCL smoke test timeout/backoff + network throughput threshold — owner?

Nina Petrova: I can propose thresholds but we need data. For new region we should start with conservative timeouts (avoid false quarantine). Also: NCCL is very sensitive to fabric/placement. If the cluster isn’t configured like us-east, this won’t be apples-to-apples.

Rafael Mendes: suggest: keep NCCL as REQUIRED but allow 1 retry before quarantine. And cap quarantine % per pool before auto-halt.

Gabe Wilson: orchestrator already supports per-step retry/backoff config. We can set: `nccl_smoke: max_attempts=2, backoff=120s` for stage2.

Aisha Bello: SRE wants an auto-halt trigger if `validation_failure_rate > 10%` over 30m in the new region. That can be a feature-flagged safeguard.

Keiko Yamamoto: + also cap autoscale ramp during first 24h (no more than +N nodes/hour) so we don’t amplify failures.

Harish Reddy: 7) Comms: stage2 rollout announcement + oncall coverage — owner?

Connor O'Brien: I’ll draft. Need sign-off from Vanessa + Rafael on owner rotations.

Vanessa Ortiz: oncall: Infra primary + Platform secondary. SRE should be FYI (paging only if SLO breach + sustained).

Rafael Mendes: ok, but please ensure the alert routing is correct for the new region. We don’t want to page the wrong team.

Harish Reddy: additional notes: AWS TAM mentioned a “known issue” with one us-west AZ having intermittent network jitter for large flows. If we can avoid that AZ for stage2, we should.

Jamal Pierce: we can bias capacity away from that AZ. Need the subnet list from networking.

Nina Petrova: if we do that, verify placement groups are still effective. Splitting across too many subnets can kill intra-node perf.

Gabe Wilson: action item: I’ll open a Linear follow-up for “stage2 region readiness checklist + networking deps” so we don’t lose this thread.

Aisha Bello: please include a dashboard bookmark specifically filtered to region=us-west and gpu=a100 once it exists. Makes gameday easier.

Sahana Iyer: update: KMS key issue is `kms:CreateGrant` missing for the image copy role in us-west. I have an MR up with IAM. Will post link when merged.

Vanessa Ortiz: networking oncall says they’re “pretty sure” us-west GPU subnets are jumbo but will confirm by checking `net-ops` terraform. I’ll report back.

Harish Reddy: thanks. summary as of now:
- MTU parity: Nina + Vanessa to confirm target + make validation FAIL (flagged)
- SG/egress: Vanessa (include logs/artifacts)
- readiness svc DNS: Gabe coordinating w/ Platform
- terraform parity + autoscale caps: Keiko
- AMI stable copy: Sahana
- validation retries/timeouts + auto-halt: Gabe + SRE review (Rafael/Aisha)
- comms/oncall: Connor
If anything missing, reply here.

Rafael Mendes: last ask: please run a mini-gameday in staging for us-west config (simulate MTU mismatch + blocked egress) before prod nodes. Doesn’t need to be huge, just confirm failures are actionable.

Vanessa Ortiz: +1, we’ll do a staging bring-up with 2 nodes and validate we get clean failure reasons + artifacts. :thumbsup:

Connor O'Brien: ok, I’ll add “staging dry run completed” as a go/no-go checkbox.

Jamal Pierce: keep me looped. I need a decision by Friday 12pm PT to keep the capacity window.

Harish Reddy: ack. I’ll post daily updates in this thread until stage2 is greenlit.
